newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 7,434 to dlr on Aug 5 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 7,434 to dlr on Aug 5 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Tuesday it had calculated the indicative rate of the leu at 7,434 to the dollar for August 5.

The rate, which is not compulsory for book-keeping operations or inter-bank deals, is used by the finance ministry, customs authorities, prosecutors' offices and police, as well as for statistical purposes.
It is computed daily, based on prices quoted by commercial banks operating on Romania's foreign exchange market.
The rate was 7,407 lei to the dollar on Monday.
